WITH
-- Filter transactions paid in EUR and aggregate consumption by CustomerID and year
consumption_by_year AS (
    SELECT
        c.Segment,
        strftime('%Y', t.Date) AS Year,
        t.CustomerID,
        SUM(t.Amount * t.Price) AS Consumption
    FROM transactions_1k t
    JOIN customers c ON t.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Currency = 'EUR'
      AND strftime('%Y', t.Date) IN ('2012', '2013')
      AND c.Segment IN ('SME', 'LAM', 'KAM')
    GROUP BY c.Segment, t.CustomerID, Year
),
-- Aggregate consumption by segment and year
segment_year_consumption AS (
    SELECT
        Segment,
        Year,
        SUM(Consumption) AS TotalConsumption
    FROM consumption_by_year
    GROUP BY Segment, Year
),
-- Calculate increase and percentage increase per segment
segment_increase AS (
    SELECT
        s2013.Segment,
        s2013.TotalConsumption AS Consumption2013,
        COALESCE(s2013.TotalConsumption - s2012.TotalConsumption, s2013.TotalConsumption) AS Increase,
        CASE 
            WHEN s2013.TotalConsumption = 0 THEN NULL
            ELSE ((s2013.TotalConsumption - COALESCE(s2012.TotalConsumption, 0)) / s2013.TotalConsumption) * 100
        END AS PercentageIncrease
    FROM segment_year_consumption s2013
    LEFT JOIN segment_year_consumption s2012
        ON s2013.Segment = s2012.Segment AND s2012.Year = '2012'
    WHERE s2013.Year = '2013'
)
SELECT
    (SELECT Segment FROM segment_increase ORDER BY PercentageIncrease DESC LIMIT 1) AS SegmentWithBiggestIncrease,
    (SELECT PercentageIncrease FROM segment_increase ORDER BY PercentageIncrease DESC LIMIT 1) AS BiggestPercentageIncrease,
    (SELECT Segment FROM segment_increase ORDER BY PercentageIncrease ASC LIMIT 1) AS SegmentWithLowestIncrease,
    (SELECT PercentageIncrease FROM segment_increase ORDER BY PercentageIncrease ASC LIMIT 1) AS LowestPercentageIncrease

WITH cons_2012_2013 AS (
    SELECT 
        c.Segment,
        substr(y.Date, 1, 4) AS Year,
        SUM(y.Consumption) AS TotalConsumption
    FROM yearmonth y
    JOIN customers c ON y.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Segment IN ('SME', 'LAM', 'KAM')
      AND c.Currency = 'EUR'
      AND substr(y.Date, 1, 4) IN ('2012', '2013')
    GROUP BY c.Segment, Year
),
cons_pivot AS (
    SELECT
        Segment,
        MAX(CASE WHEN Year = '2012' THEN TotalConsumption ELSE 0 END) AS Cons2012,
        MAX(CASE WHEN Year = '2013' THEN TotalConsumption ELSE 0 END) AS Cons2013
    FROM cons_2012_2013
    GROUP BY Segment
),
cons_change AS (
    SELECT
        Segment,
        Cons2013,
        Cons2012,
        (Cons2013 - Cons2012) AS IncreaseOrDecrease,
        CASE WHEN Cons2013 != 0 THEN ((Cons2013 - Cons2012) * 100.0 / Cons2013) ELSE NULL END AS PercentageIncrease
    FROM cons_pivot
)
SELECT 
    'Biggest Increase' AS Type,
    Segment,
    PercentageIncrease
FROM cons_change
WHERE PercentageIncrease = (SELECT MAX(PercentageIncrease) FROM cons_change)
UNION ALL
SELECT 
    'Lowest Increase' AS Type,
    Segment,
    PercentageIncrease
FROM cons_change
WHERE PercentageIncrease = (SELECT MIN(PercentageIncrease) FROM cons_change)

        c.Segment,
        substr(y.Date, 1, 4) AS Year,
        SUM(y.Consumption) AS TotalConsumption

    WHERE c.Currency = 'EUR' AND substr(y.Date, 1, 4) IN ('2012', '2013')
      AND c.Segment IN ('SME', 'LAM', 'KAM')
    GROUP BY c.Segment, Year
),
diffs AS (
    SELECT
        c2013.Segment,
        c2013.TotalConsumption AS Consumption2013,
        c2013.TotalConsumption - COALESCE(c2012.TotalConsumption, 0) AS IncreaseOrDecrease,

        (SELECT * FROM consumption_2012_2013 WHERE Year = '2013') c2013
    LEFT JOIN 
        (SELECT * FROM consumption_2012_2013 WHERE Year = '2012') c2012
    ON c2013.Segment = c2012.Segment
)

    SELECT 
        ym.CustomerID,
        SUM(ym.Consumption) AS total_consumption
    FROM yearmonth ym
    JOIN customers c ON ym.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Segment = 'LAM'
    GROUP BY ym.CustomerID
),
lam_counts AS (
    SELECT 
        COUNT(*) AS total_lam_customers,
        SUM(CASE WHEN total_consumption > 46.73 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS customers_above_46_73

)

FROM lam_counts

WITH SME_Customers AS (
    SELECT CustomerID, Currency
    FROM customers
    WHERE Segment = 'SME'
),
SME_Transactions AS (
    SELECT t.CustomerID, c.Currency, SUM(t.Price * t.Amount) AS TotalPayment
    FROM transactions_1k t
    JOIN SME_Customers c ON t.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
    GROUP BY t.CustomerID, c.Currency
),
Currency_Sums AS (
    SELECT Currency, SUM(TotalPayment) AS TotalPayment
    FROM SME_Transactions
    GROUP BY Currency
)
SELECT 
    CASE 
        WHEN COALESCE((SELECT TotalPayment FROM Currency_Sums WHERE Currency = 'CZK'), 0) > COALESCE((SELECT TotalPayment FROM Currency_Sums WHERE Currency = 'EUR'), 0)
        THEN 'True'
        ELSE 'False'
    END AS More_SMEs_pay_in_CZK,
    COALESCE((SELECT TotalPayment FROM Currency_Sums WHERE Currency = 'CZK'), 0) - COALESCE((SELECT TotalPayment FROM Currency_Sums WHERE Currency = 'EUR'), 0) AS Difference

WITH RankedSchools AS (
    SELECT 
        `School Name`,
        `Free Meal Count (K-12)`,
        `Enrollment (K-12)`,
        CASE 
            WHEN `Enrollment (K-12)` > 0 THEN `Free Meal Count (K-12)` / `Enrollment (K-12)`
            ELSE NULL
        END AS EligibleFreeRate,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY `Enrollment (K-12)` DESC) AS rn
    FROM frpm
    WHERE `Enrollment (K-12)` IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT 
    `School Name`,
    EligibleFreeRate
FROM RankedSchools
WHERE rn IN (10, 11)

WITH GermanDrivers AS (
    SELECT driverId, forename || ' ' || surname AS fullName
    FROM drivers
    WHERE nationality = 'German'
      AND CAST(strftime('%Y', dob) AS INTEGER) BETWEEN 1980 AND 1985
),
AvgPitStopDuration AS (
    SELECT p.driverId, AVG(CAST(SUBSTR(p.duration, 1, LENGTH(p.duration)-1) AS REAL)) AS avgDuration
    FROM pitStops p
    JOIN GermanDrivers gd ON p.driverId = gd.driverId
    WHERE p.duration IS NOT NULL AND p.duration != ''
    GROUP BY p.driverId
)
SELECT gd.fullName, apd.avgDuration
FROM AvgPitStopDuration apd
JOIN GermanDrivers gd ON apd.driverId = gd.driverId
ORDER BY apd.avgDuration ASC
LIMIT 3

WITH AbnormalUA AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT p.ID, p.SEX
    FROM Patient p
    JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID
    WHERE (p.SEX = 'M' AND l.UA <= 8.0)
       OR (p.SEX = 'F' AND l.UA <= 6.5)
)
SELECT 
    CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN SEX = 'M' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS FLOAT) /
    NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN SEX = 'F' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS Male_to_Female_Ratio
FROM AbnormalUA

WITH Top3Youngest AS (
    SELECT code, dob
    FROM drivers
    WHERE code IS NOT NULL AND code != ''
    ORDER BY dob DESC
    LIMIT 3
),
NetherlandicCount AS (
    SELECT COUNT(*) AS count
    FROM drivers
    WHERE nationality IN ('Dutch', 'Netherlandic')
      AND code IN (SELECT code FROM Top3Youngest)
)
SELECT 
    (SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(code, ', ') FROM Top3Youngest) AS top3_codes,
    (SELECT count FROM NetherlandicCount) AS netherlandic_count

WITH Top3Youngest AS (
    SELECT driverId, code, dob
    FROM drivers
    WHERE dob IS NOT NULL
    ORDER BY dob DESC
    LIMIT 3
)
SELECT 
    GROUP_CONCAT(code, ', ') AS top3_codes,
    SUM(CASE WHEN nationality = 'Dutch' OR nationality = 'Netherlandic' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS netherlandic_count
FROM Top3Youngest t
JOIN drivers d ON t.driverId = d.driverId

WITH Top3Youngest AS (
    SELECT code
    FROM drivers
    WHERE dob IS NOT NULL
    ORDER BY dob DESC
    LIMIT 3
)
SELECT 
    (SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(code, ', ') FROM Top3Youngest) AS top3_codes,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM drivers WHERE code IN (SELECT code FROM Top3Youngest) AND nationality = 'Dutch') AS netherlandic_count

WITH youngest_drivers AS (
    SELECT driverId, code, (strftime('%Y', 'now') - strftime('%Y', dob)) AS age
    FROM drivers
    WHERE dob IS NOT NULL
    ORDER BY age ASC
    LIMIT 3
)
SELECT 
    (SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(code, ', ') FROM youngest_drivers) AS top_3_youngest_driver_codes,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM youngest_drivers d JOIN drivers dr ON d.driverId = dr.driverId WHERE dr.nationality = 'Dutch' OR dr.nationality = 'Netherlandic') AS netherlandic_count

WITH youngest_drivers AS (
    SELECT driverId, code, (julianday('now') - julianday(dob)) / 365.25 AS age_years
    FROM drivers
    WHERE dob IS NOT NULL
    ORDER BY age_years ASC
    LIMIT 3
)
SELECT 
    GROUP_CONCAT(code, ', ') AS top_3_youngest_driver_codes,
    SUM(CASE WHEN nationality = 'Dutch' OR nationality = 'Netherlandic' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS netherlandic_count
FROM youngest_drivers yd
JOIN drivers d ON yd.driverId = d.driverId

SELECT 
    (SUM(CASE WHEN e.event_name = 'Yearly Kickoff' THEN ex.cost ELSE 0 END) * 100.0) / 
    SUM(ex.cost) AS percentage_cost_yearly_kickoff
FROM expense ex
JOIN budget b ON ex.link_to_budget = b.budget_id
JOIN event e ON b.link_to_event = e.event_id

SELECT 
    ROUND(
        100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN e.event_name = 'Yearly Kickoff' THEN ex.cost ELSE 0 END) / 
        NULLIF(SUM(ex.cost), 0), 2
    ) AS yearly_kickoff_cost_percentage
FROM expense ex

JOIN event e ON b.link_to_event = e.event_id

JOIN budget b ON ex.link_to_budget = b.budget_id
JOIN event e ON b.link_to_event = e.event_id

    ROUND(
        100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN e.event_name = 'Yearly Kickoff' THEN ex.cost ELSE 0 END) / 
        NULLIF(SUM(ex.cost), 0), 2
    ) AS percentage_cost_yearly_kickoff
FROM expense ex
JOIN budget b ON ex.link_to_budget = b.budget_id
JOIN event e ON b.link_to_event = e.event_id

SELECT 
    (SUM(CASE WHEN e.event_name = 'Yearly Kickoff' THEN ex.cost ELSE 0 END) * 100.0) / SUM(ex.cost) AS percentage
FROM expense ex
JOIN budget b ON ex.link_to_budget = b.budget_id
JOIN event e ON b.link_to_event = e.event_id

WITH yearly_kickoff_cost AS (
    SELECT SUM(e.cost) AS total_cost
    FROM expense e
    JOIN budget b ON e.link_to_budget = b.budget_id
    JOIN event ev ON b.link_to_event = ev.event_id
    WHERE ev.event_name = 'Yearly Kickoff'
),
total_cost AS (
    SELECT SUM(cost) AS total_cost FROM expense
)
SELECT 
    CASE 
        WHEN total_cost.total_cost = 0 THEN 0
        ELSE (yearly_kickoff_cost.total_cost * 100.0) / total_cost.total_cost
    END AS percentage_cost_for_yearly_kickoff
FROM yearly_kickoff_cost, total_cost

SELECT 
    ROUND(
        100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id) 
        / (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c2.client_id)
           FROM client c2
           JOIN disp d2 ON c2.client_id = d2.client_id
           JOIN account a2 ON d2.account_id = a2.account_id
           WHERE a2.frequency = 'POPLATEK TYDNE'), 2) AS male_weekly_statement_percentage
FROM client c
JOIN disp d ON c.client_id = d.client_id
JOIN account a ON d.account_id = a.account_id
WHERE c.gender = 'M' 
  AND a.frequency = 'POPLATEK TYDNE'

    ROUND(
        100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id) FILTER (WHERE c.gender = 'M') / 
        COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id), 2
    ) AS male_weekly_statement_percentage

WITH HamiltonResults AS (
    SELECT r.raceId, r.year, res.position
    FROM results res
    JOIN drivers d ON res.driverId = d.driverId
    JOIN races r ON res.raceId = r.raceId
    WHERE d.surname = 'Hamilton' AND r.year >= 2010
),
FirstCircuit AS (
    SELECT circuitId
    FROM races
    WHERE year >= 2010
    GROUP BY circuitId
    ORDER BY MIN(date) ASC
    LIMIT 1
),
HamiltonFirstCircuitResults AS (
    SELECT hr.position
    FROM HamiltonResults hr
    JOIN races r ON hr.raceId = r.raceId
    JOIN FirstCircuit fc ON r.circuitId = fc.circuitId
)
SELECT 
    ROUND(
        100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN position > 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / COUNT(*)
    , 2) AS percentage_not_first_position
FROM HamiltonFirstCircuitResults

WITH Hamilton_Races AS (
    SELECT r.raceId, r.round
    FROM results res
    JOIN drivers d ON res.driverId = d.driverId
    JOIN races r ON res.raceId = r.raceId
    WHERE d.surname = 'Hamilton' AND r.year >= 2010
),
First_Track_Rounds AS (
    SELECT year, MIN(round) AS first_round
    FROM races
    WHERE year >= 2010
    GROUP BY year

Hamilton_Race_With_First_Track AS (
    SELECT hr.raceId, r.year, r.round, ftr.first_round

WITH CommunityPosts AS (
    SELECT p.Id
    FROM posts p
    JOIN users u ON p.OwnerUserId = u.Id
    WHERE u.DisplayName = 'Community'
),
CommunityPostsCount AS (
    SELECT COUNT(*) AS total
    FROM CommunityPosts
),
CommunityRPostsCount AS (
    SELECT COUNT(*) AS r_count
    FROM CommunityPosts cp
    JOIN posts p ON cp.Id = p.Id
    WHERE p.Tags LIKE '%<r>%'
)
SELECT 
    CASE 
        WHEN total = 0 THEN 0
        ELSE CAST(r_count AS FLOAT) / total 
    END AS percentage
FROM CommunityPostsCount, CommunityRPostsCount

WITH total_heroes AS (
    SELECT COUNT(id) AS total_count
    FROM superhero
),
bad_heroes AS (
    SELECT s.id, p.publisher_name
    FROM superhero s
    JOIN alignment a ON s.alignment_id = a.id
    LEFT JOIN publisher p ON s.publisher_id = p.id
    WHERE a.alignment = 'Bad'
),
bad_heroes_count AS (
    SELECT COUNT(*) AS bad_count
    FROM bad_heroes
),
marvel_bad_heroes_count AS (
    SELECT COUNT(*) AS marvel_bad_count
    FROM bad_heroes
    WHERE publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics'
)
SELECT 
    ROUND((bad_heroes_count.bad_count * 100.0) / total_heroes.total_count, 2) AS percentage_bad_heroes,
    marvel_bad_heroes_count.marvel_bad_count AS marvel_bad_heroes
FROM total_heroes, bad_heroes_count, marvel_bad_heroes_count

SELECT 
    ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN a.alignment = 'Bad' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(s.id), 2) AS percentage_bad_alignment,
    SUM(CASE WHEN a.alignment = 'Bad' AND p.publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS marvel_bad_count
FROM superhero s
LEFT JOIN alignment a ON s.alignment_id = a.id
LEFT JOIN publisher p ON s.publisher_id = p.id

SELECT 
    f.`School Name`,
    f.`FRPM Count (K-12)`,
    f.`Enrollment (K-12)`,
    CASE 
        WHEN f.`Enrollment (K-12)` > 0 THEN f.`FRPM Count (K-12)` / f.`Enrollment (K-12)`
        ELSE NULL
    END AS eligible_frpm_rate
FROM frpm f
JOIN schools s ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
WHERE s.DOC = '66'
  AND f.`Enrollment (K-12)` > 0
ORDER BY f.`FRPM Count (K-12)` DESC
LIMIT 5

SELECT d.driverRef
FROM qualifying q
JOIN drivers d ON q.driverId = d.driverId
WHERE q.raceId = 20
ORDER BY q.q1 DESC
LIMIT 5

WITH q1_times AS (
    SELECT driverId, q1
    FROM qualifying
    WHERE raceId = 20
      AND q1 IS NOT NULL
      AND q1 != ''
),
max_q1 AS (
    SELECT MAX(q1) AS max_q1_time
    FROM q1_times
)
SELECT d.driverRef
FROM qualifying q
JOIN dRivers d ON q.driverId = d.driverId
JOIN max_q1 m ON q.q1 = m.max_q1_time
WHERE q.raceId = 20
ORDER BY d.driverRef

    WHERE A3 = 'South Bohemia'

    (strftime('%Y', P.`First Date`) - strftime('%Y', P.Birthday)) AS Age_at_First_Date
FROM Patient P
JOIN Examination E ON P.ID = E.ID
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE E.Diagnosis = 'SJS'
ORDER BY P.Birthday ASC, L.Date ASC
LIMIT 1

SELECT 
    p.player_name,
    CAST((julianday('now') - julianday(p.birthday)) / 365.25 AS INTEGER) AS age
FROM 
    Player p
JOIN 
    Player_Attributes pa ON p.player_api_id = pa.player_api_id
WHERE 
    pa.sprint_speed >= 97
    AND substr(pa.date, 1, 4) BETWEEN '2013' AND '2015'
GROUP BY 
    p.player_api_id

WITH K8_Magnet_Schools AS (
    SELECT 
        frpm.CDSCode,
        frpm.`School Name`,
        frpm.`County Name`,
        frpm.`District Name`,
        frpm.`School Type`,
        frpm.`NSLP Provision Status`,
        frpm.`Low Grade`,
        frpm.`High Grade`,
        schools.City,
        schools.Magnet
    FROM frpm
    JOIN schools ON frpm.CDSCode = schools.CDSCode
    WHERE schools.Magnet = 1
      AND (
          (frpm.`Low Grade` = 'K' OR frpm.`Low Grade` = 'Kindergarten')
          AND (frpm.`High Grade` = '8' OR frpm.`High Grade` = '8th')
      )
),
Multiple_Provision_Count AS (
    SELECT COUNT(*) AS MultipleProvisionCount
    FROM K8_Magnet_Schools
    WHERE `NSLP Provision Status` = 'Multiple Provision Types'
),
City_School_Count AS (
    SELECT 
        City,
        COUNT(*) AS SchoolCount
    FROM frpm
    JOIN schools ON frpm.CDSCode = schools.CDSCode
    WHERE (frpm.`Low Grade` = 'K' OR frpm.`Low Grade` = 'Kindergarten')
      AND (frpm.`High Grade` = '8' OR frpm.`High Grade` = '8th')
    GROUP BY City
),
City_Count AS (
    SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT City) AS CityCount
    FROM frpm
    JOIN schools ON frpm.CDSCode = schools.CDSCode
    WHERE (frpm.`Low Grade` = 'K' OR frpm.`Low Grade` = 'Kindergarten')
      AND (frpm.`High Grade` = '8' OR frpm.`High Grade` = '8th')
)

SELECT 
    (SELECT MultipleProvisionCount FROM Multiple_Provision_Count) AS Magnet_K8_MultipleProvisionSchools,
    (SELECT CityCount FROM City_Count) AS Cities_Offering_K8,
    City,
    SchoolCount
FROM City_School_Count
ORDER BY City

    AdmFName3 || ' ' || AdmLName3 AS Admin3_FullName

WHERE CDSCode = (
    SELECT cds
    FROM satscores
    WHERE NumGE1500 = (
        SELECT MAX(NumGE1500)
        FROM satscores
    )
)

WITH max_numge1500 AS (
    SELECT cds, NumGE1500
    FROM satscores
    WHERE NumGE1500 IS NOT NULL
    ORDER BY NumGE1500 DESC
    LIMIT 1
)

    COALESCE(s.AdmFName1 || ' ' || s.AdmLName1, '') AS Admin1_FullName,

    WHERE NumGE1500 IS NOT NULL

top_school AS (
    SELECT s.CDSCode

    JOIN max_sat m ON s.cds = m.cds AND s.NumGE1500 = m.max_numge1500

    COALESCE(AdmFName1 || ' ' || AdmLName1, '') AS Admin1_FullName,

WITH FirstRace AS (
    SELECT 
        d.driverId,
        MIN(r.date) AS first_race_date
    FROM drivers d
    JOIN results res ON d.driverId = res.driverId
    JOIN races r ON res.raceId = r.raceId
    GROUP BY d.driverId
),
YoungestDriver AS (
    SELECT 
        driverId,
        forename || ' ' || surname AS full_name,
        nationality,
        dob
    FROM drivers
    ORDER BY dob DESC
    LIMIT 1
)
SELECT 
    yd.full_name,
    yd.nationality,
    r.name AS first_race_name
FROM YoungestDriver yd
JOIN FirstRace fr ON yd.driverId = fr.driverId
JOIN races r ON r.date = fr.first_race_date AND r.raceId IN (
    SELECT raceId FROM results WHERE driverId = yd.driverId
)
ORDER BY r.date
LIMIT 1

WITH youngest_driver AS (
    SELECT driverId, forename || ' ' || surname AS full_name, nationality, dob
    FROM drivers
    ORDER BY dob DESC
    LIMIT 1
),
first_race AS (
    SELECT r.name AS race_name, r.date
    FROM results res
    JOIN races r ON res.raceId = r.raceId
    JOIN youngest_driver yd ON res.driverId = yd.driverId
    ORDER BY r.date ASC
    LIMIT 1
)
SELECT yd.full_name, yd.nationality, fr.race_name
FROM youngest_driver yd
CROSS JOIN first_race fr

WITH
-- Filter customers by segment and currency CZK
customers_czk AS (
    SELECT CustomerID, Segment
    FROM customers
    WHERE Currency = 'CZK'
),
-- Sum consumption per customer for 2013
consumption_2013 AS (
    SELECT ym.CustomerID, SUM(ym.Consumption) AS total_consumption
    FROM yearmonth ym
    JOIN customers_czk c ON ym.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
    WHERE ym.Date BETWEEN '201301' AND '201312'
    GROUP BY ym.CustomerID
),
-- Find minimum consumption per segment
min_consumption_per_segment AS (
    SELECT c.Segment, MIN(co.total_consumption) AS min_consumption
    FROM consumption_2013 co
    JOIN customers_czk c ON co.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
    GROUP BY c.Segment
),
-- Customers with minimum consumption per segment
min_consumers AS (
    SELECT c.Segment, co.CustomerID, co.total_consumption
    FROM consumption_2013 co
    JOIN customers_czk c ON co.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
    JOIN min_consumption_per_segment mcs ON c.Segment = mcs.Segment AND co.total_consumption = mcs.min_consumption
),
-- Annual average consumption of customers with minimum consumption per segment
annual_avg_min_consumption AS (
    SELECT
        Segment,
        SUM(total_consumption) * 1.0 / COUNT(CustomerID) AS annual_avg
    FROM min_consumers
    GROUP BY Segment
)
SELECT
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM annual_avg_min_consumption WHERE Segment = 'SME') -
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM annual_avg_min_consumption WHERE Segment = 'LAM') AS diff_SME_LAM,
    
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM annual_avg_min_consumption WHERE Segment = 'LAM') -
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM annual_avg_min_consumption WHERE Segment = 'KAM') AS diff_LAM_KAM,
    
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM annual_avg_min_consumption WHERE Segment = 'KAM') -
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM annual_avg_min_consumption WHERE Segment = 'SME') AS diff_KAM_SME

    FROM consumption_czk c
    JOIN min_consumption_per_segment m
      ON c.Segment = m.Segment AND c.total_consumption = m.min_consumption
),

    (SELECT annual_avg FROM annual_avg_min_consumption WHERE Segment = 'LAM') AS diff_SME_LAM,
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM annual_avg_min_consumption WHERE Segment = 'LAM') -
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM annual_avg_min_consumption WHERE Segment = 'KAM') AS diff_LAM_KAM,
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM annual_avg_min_consumption WHERE Segment = 'KAM') -
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM annual_avg_min_consumption WHERE Segment = 'SME') AS diff_KAM_SME

WITH
-- Filter customers by currency CZK
czk_customers AS (
    SELECT CustomerID, Segment
    FROM customers
    WHERE Currency = 'CZK'
),
-- Sum consumption per customer for 2013
consumption_2013 AS (
    SELECT ym.CustomerID, SUM(ym.Consumption) AS total_consumption
    FROM yearmonth ym
    JOIN czk_customers c ON ym.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
    WHERE substr(ym.Date, 1, 4) = '2013'
    GROUP BY ym.CustomerID
),
-- Find minimum consumption per segment
min_consumption_per_segment AS (
    SELECT c.Segment, MIN(c2013.total_consumption) AS min_consumption
    FROM consumption_2013 c2013
    JOIN czk_customers c ON c2013.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
    GROUP BY c.Segment
),
-- Customers with minimum consumption per segment
min_consumers AS (
    SELECT c.Segment, c2013.CustomerID, c2013.total_consumption
    FROM consumption_2013 c2013
    JOIN czk_customers c ON c2013.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
    JOIN min_consumption_per_segment m ON c.Segment = m.Segment AND c2013.total_consumption = m.min_consumption
),
-- Calculate annual average consumption of customers with minimum consumption per segment
annual_avg_min_consumption AS (
    SELECT Segment, AVG(total_consumption) AS avg_consumption
    FROM min_consumers
    GROUP BY Segment
)
SELECT
    (SELECT avg_consumption FROM annual_avg_min_consumption WHERE Segment = 'SME') -
    (SELECT avg_consumption FROM annual_avg_min_consumption WHERE Segment = 'LAM') AS SME_minus_LAM,
    (SELECT avg_consumption FROM annual_avg_min_consumption WHERE Segment = 'LAM') -
    (SELECT avg_consumption FROM annual_avg_min_consumption WHERE Segment = 'KAM') AS LAM_minus_KAM,
    (SELECT avg_consumption FROM annual_avg_min_consumption WHERE Segment = 'KAM') -
    (SELECT avg_consumption FROM annual_avg_min_consumption WHERE Segment = 'SME') AS KAM_minus_SME

WITH
-- Filter customers by currency CZK
czk_customers AS (
    SELECT CustomerID, Segment
    FROM customers
    WHERE Currency = 'CZK'
),
-- Sum consumption per customer for 2013
consumption_2013 AS (
    SELECT ym.CustomerID, SUM(ym.Consumption) AS total_consumption
    FROM yearmonth ym
    WHERE substr(ym.Date, 1, 4) = '2013'
    GROUP BY ym.CustomerID
),
-- Join consumption with customers filtered by CZK currency
consumption_czk AS (
    SELECT c.CustomerID, c.Segment, co.total_consumption
    FROM czk_customers c
    JOIN consumption_2013 co ON c.CustomerID = co.CustomerID
),
-- Find minimum consumption per segment
min_consumption_per_segment AS (
    SELECT Segment, MIN(total_consumption) AS min_consumption
    FROM consumption_czk
    GROUP BY Segment
),
-- Customers with minimum consumption per segment
min_consumers AS (
    SELECT cc.Segment, cc.CustomerID, cc.total_consumption
    FROM consumption_czk cc
    JOIN min_consumption_per_segment m
      ON cc.Segment = m.Segment AND cc.total_consumption = m.min_consumption
),
-- Count of min consumers per segment
min_consumers_count AS (
    SELECT Segment, COUNT(*) AS cnt
    FROM min_consumers
    GROUP BY Segment
),
-- Annual average consumption of min consumers per segment
annual_avg_min_consumption AS (
    SELECT m.Segment,
           SUM(m.total_consumption) / mc.cnt AS annual_avg
    FROM min_consumers m
    JOIN min_consumers_count mc ON m.Segment = mc.Segment
    GROUP BY m.Segment
),
-- Select annual averages for SME, LAM, KAM
avg_sme AS (SELECT annual_avg FROM annual_avg_min_consumption WHERE Segment = 'SME'),
avg_lam AS (SELECT annual_avg FROM annual_avg_min_consumption WHERE Segment = 'LAM'),
avg_kam AS (SELECT annual_avg FROM annual_avg_min_consumption WHERE Segment = 'KAM')

SELECT
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM avg_sme) - (SELECT annual_avg FROM avg_lam) AS diff_SME_LAM,
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM avg_lam) - (SELECT annual_avg FROM avg_kam) AS diff_LAM_KAM,
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM avg_kam) - (SELECT annual_avg FROM avg_sme) AS diff_KAM_SME

WITH 
-- Filter customers by segment and currency CZK
customers_czk AS (
    SELECT CustomerID, Segment
    FROM customers
    WHERE Currency = 'CZK' AND Segment IN ('SME', 'LAM', 'KAM')
),
-- Sum annual consumption per customer for 2013
annual_consumption AS (
    SELECT ym.CustomerID, SUM(ym.Consumption) AS total_consumption
    FROM yearmonth ym
    WHERE substr(ym.Date,1,4) = '2013'
    GROUP BY ym.CustomerID
),
-- Join with customers to get segment and filter only CZK customers
consumption_segment AS (
    SELECT c.Segment, ac.CustomerID, ac.total_consumption
    FROM annual_consumption ac
    JOIN customers_czk c ON ac.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
),
-- Find minimum consumption per segment
min_consumption_per_segment AS (
    SELECT Segment, MIN(total_consumption) AS min_consumption
    FROM consumption_segment
    GROUP BY Segment
),
-- Find customers with minimum consumption per segment
min_consumers AS (
    SELECT cs.Segment, cs.CustomerID, cs.total_consumption
    FROM consumption_segment cs
    JOIN min_consumption_per_segment mcs 
      ON cs.Segment = mcs.Segment AND cs.total_consumption = mcs.min_consumption
),
-- Calculate annual average consumption of customers with minimum consumption per segment
annual_avg_min_consumption AS (
    SELECT Segment, AVG(total_consumption) AS avg_consumption
    FROM min_consumers
    GROUP BY Segment
)
SELECT
    (SELECT avg_consumption FROM annual_avg_min_consumption WHERE Segment = 'SME') -
    (SELECT avg_consumption FROM annual_avg_min_consumption WHERE Segment = 'LAM') AS diff_SME_LAM,
    
    (SELECT avg_consumption FROM annual_avg_min_consumption WHERE Segment = 'LAM') -
    (SELECT avg_consumption FROM annual_avg_min_consumption WHERE Segment = 'KAM') AS diff_LAM_KAM,
    
    (SELECT avg_consumption FROM annual_avg_min_consumption WHERE Segment = 'KAM') -
    (SELECT avg_consumption FROM annual_avg_min_consumption WHERE Segment = 'SME') AS diff_KAM_SME

WITH 
-- Filter transactions in 2013 paid in CZK and join with customers to get segments
trans_2013_czk AS (
    SELECT 
        t.CustomerID,
        c.Segment,
        t.Amount * t.Price AS Consumption
    FROM transactions_1k t
    JOIN customers c ON t.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
    WHERE t.Date BETWEEN '20130101' AND '20131231'
      AND c.Currency = 'CZK'
),
-- Sum consumption per customer for 2013
customer_consumption AS (
    SELECT 
        CustomerID,
        Segment,
        SUM(Consumption) AS TotalConsumption
    FROM trans_2013_czk
    GROUP BY CustomerID, Segment
),
-- Find minimum consumption per segment
min_consumption_per_segment AS (
    SELECT 
        Segment,
        MIN(TotalConsumption) AS MinConsumption
    FROM customer_consumption
    GROUP BY Segment
),
-- Customers with minimum consumption per segment
min_consumers AS (
    SELECT 
        cc.Segment,
        cc.CustomerID,
        cc.TotalConsumption
    FROM customer_consumption cc
    JOIN min_consumption_per_segment mcs 
      ON cc.Segment = mcs.Segment AND cc.TotalConsumption = mcs.MinConsumption
),
-- Calculate annual average consumption of customers with minimum consumption per segment
annual_avg_min_consumption AS (
    SELECT 
        Segment,
        AVG(TotalConsumption) AS AnnualAvgConsumption
    FROM min_consumers
    GROUP BY Segment
)
SELECT
    (SELECT AnnualAvgConsumption FROM annual_avg_min_consumption WHERE Segment = 'SME') -
    (SELECT AnnualAvgConsumption FROM annual_avg_min_consumption WHERE Segment = 'LAM') AS SME_minus_LAM,
    
    (SELECT AnnualAvgConsumption FROM annual_avg_min_consumption WHERE Segment = 'LAM') -
    (SELECT AnnualAvgConsumption FROM annual_avg_min_consumption WHERE Segment = 'KAM') AS LAM_minus_KAM,
    
    (SELECT AnnualAvgConsumption FROM annual_avg_min_consumption WHERE Segment = 'KAM') -
    (SELECT AnnualAvgConsumption FROM annual_avg_min_consumption WHERE Segment = 'SME') AS KAM_minus_SME

        t.CustomerID,
        SUM(t.Price) AS TotalSpent,
        SUM(t.Amount) AS TotalAmount
    FROM transactions_1k t
    GROUP BY t.CustomerID
),
TopCustomer AS (
    SELECT 
        CustomerID,
        TotalSpent,
        TotalAmount,
        TotalSpent / TotalAmount AS AvgPricePerItem
    FROM CustomerSpending
    ORDER BY TotalSpent DESC
    LIMIT 1
)
SELECT 
    c.CustomerID,
    tc.AvgPricePerItem,
    c.Currency
FROM TopCustomer tc
JOIN customers c ON c.CustomerID = tc.CustomerID

SELECT 
    y.CustomerID,
    y.Consumption
FROM 
    transactions_1k t
JOIN 
    yearmonth y ON t.CustomerID = y.CustomerID AND y.Date = '201208'
WHERE 
    t.ProductID = 5
    AND (t.Price * 1.0 / t.Amount) > 29.00
GROUP BY 
    y.CustomerID, y.Consumption

    SELECT DISTINCT t.CustomerID
    FROM transactions_1k t
    WHERE t.ProductID = 5
      AND (t.Price * 1.0 / t.Amount) > 29.00
) high_price_customers ON y.CustomerID = high_price_customers.CustomerID
WHERE y.Date = '201208'

FROM 
    member

    income ON member.member_id = income.link_to_member
WHERE

    100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN income.amount = 50 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*) AS percentage_amount_50
FROM 
    member
JOIN 
    income ON member.member_id = income.link_to_member
WHERE 
    member.t_shirt_size = 'Medium'
    AND income.source = 'Student_Club'

WITH medium_members AS (
    SELECT member_id
    FROM member
    WHERE t_shirt_size = 'Medium'
),
amount_50_received AS (
    SELECT i.link_to_member
    FROM income i
    JOIN medium_members m ON i.link_to_member = m.member_id
    WHERE i.amount = 50 AND i.source = 'Student_Club'
),
total_medium_members AS (
    SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_count FROM medium_members
),
amount_50_count AS (
    SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT link_to_member) AS count_50 FROM amount_50_received
)
SELECT 
    CASE 
        WHEN total_count = 0 THEN 0
        ELSE (count_50 * 100.0 / total_count)
    END AS percentage_amount_50_received
FROM total_medium_members, amount_50_count

    SELECT member_id
    FROM member
    WHERE t_shirt_size = 'Medium'
),
amount_50_received AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT link_to_member
    FROM income

)

    CASE 
        WHEN COUNT(m.member_id) = 0 THEN 0
        ELSE ROUND(
            100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN a.link_to_member IS NOT NULL THEN m.member_id END)

    END AS percentage_amount_50_received
FROM medium_members m

WITH MaleCounts AS (
    SELECT
        Admission,
        COUNT(ID) AS CountMale
    FROM Patient
    WHERE SEX = 'M'
    GROUP BY Admission
)
SELECT
    CASE
        WHEN inp.CountMale > outp.CountMale THEN 'More in-patient males'
        WHEN inp.CountMale < outp.CountMale THEN 'More outpatient males'
        ELSE 'Equal number of in-patient and outpatient males'
    END AS Comparison,
    inp.CountMale AS InPatientCount,
    outp.CountMale AS OutPatientCount,
    CASE
        WHEN outp.CountMale = 0 THEN NULL
        ELSE ABS((CAST(inp.CountMale AS FLOAT) - outp.CountMale) * 100.0 / outp.CountMale)
    END AS PercentageDeviation
FROM
    (SELECT CountMale FROM MaleCounts WHERE Admission = '+') inp,
    (SELECT CountMale FROM MaleCounts WHERE Admission = '-') outp

WITH MaleCounts AS (
    SELECT 
        Admission,
        COUNT(ID) AS CountMale
    FROM Patient
    WHERE SEX = 'M'
    GROUP BY Admission
)
SELECT 
    CASE 
        WHEN COALESCE((SELECT CountMale FROM MaleCounts WHERE Admission = '+'), 0) > COALESCE((SELECT CountMale FROM MaleCounts WHERE Admission = '-'), 0) 
        THEN 'More in-patient males'
        WHEN COALESCE((SELECT CountMale FROM MaleCounts WHERE Admission = '+'), 0) < COALESCE((SELECT CountMale FROM MaleCounts WHERE Admission = '-'), 0) 
        THEN 'More outpatient males'
        ELSE 'Equal number of in-patient and outpatient males'
    END AS Comparison,
    ABS(
        COALESCE((SELECT CountMale FROM MaleCounts WHERE Admission = '+'), 0) * 100.0 / NULLIF(COALESCE((SELECT CountMale FROM MaleCounts WHERE Admission = '-'), 0), 0)
        - 100
    ) AS PercentageDeviation

WITH Abnormal_Platelet AS (
    SELECT 
        ID,
        MAX(CASE WHEN PLT < 100 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS Has_Low,
        MAX(CASE WHEN PLT > 400 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS Has_High
    FROM Laboratory
    WHERE PLT IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY ID
),
Abnormal_Patients AS (
    SELECT ID
    FROM Abnormal_Platelet
    WHERE Has_Low = 1 OR Has_High = 1
)

    SUM(Has_Low) AS Patients_Lower_Than_Normal,
    SUM(Has_High) AS Patients_Higher_Than_Normal,
    SUM(Has_Low) - SUM(Has_High) AS Difference
FROM Abnormal_Platelet

WITH
  HeightStats AS (
    SELECT
      MAX(height) AS max_height,
      MIN(height) AS min_height
    FROM Player
  ),
  PlayersOfInterest AS (
    SELECT player_api_id, height
    FROM Player, HeightStats
    WHERE height = max_height OR height = min_height
  ),
  AvgFinishing AS (
    SELECT
      pa.player_api_id,
      AVG(pa.finishing) AS avg_finishing
    FROM Player_Attributes pa
    JOIN PlayersOfInterest p ON pa.player_api_id = p.player_api_id
    GROUP BY pa.player_api_id
  )
SELECT p.player_name, af.avg_finishing
FROM AvgFinishing af
JOIN Player p ON af.player_api_id = p.player_api_id
ORDER BY af.avg_finishing DESC
LIMIT 1

WITH speeds AS (
    SELECT
        r.raceId,
        CAST(REPLACE(res.fastestLapSpeed, 'kph', '') AS REAL) AS speed
    FROM results res
    JOIN drivers d ON res.driverId = d.driverId
    JOIN races r ON res.raceId = r.raceId
    WHERE d.forename = 'Paul' AND d.surname = 'di Resta' AND r.raceId IN (853, 854)
)
SELECT

FROM
    speeds s1
    JOIN speeds s2 ON s1.raceId = 853 AND s2.raceId = 854

    s.year,
    AVG(
        (CAST(SUBSTR(r.time, 1, 2) AS INTEGER) * 3600) +
        (CAST(SUBSTR(r.time, 4, 2) AS INTEGER) * 60) +
        (CAST(SUBSTR(r.time, 7, 2) AS INTEGER)) +
        (CAST(SUBSTR(r.time, 10, 3) AS INTEGER) / 1000.0)

ORDER BY

WITH Drivers_2000_2005 AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT r.driverId
    FROM results r
    JOIN drivers d ON r.driverId = d.driverId
    JOIN races ra ON r.raceId = ra.raceId
    WHERE ra.year BETWEEN 2000 AND 2005
),
Drivers_Born_Before_1985_Over_50_Laps AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT r.driverId
    FROM results r
    JOIN drivers d ON r.driverId = d.driverId
    JOIN races ra ON r.raceId = ra.raceId
    WHERE ra.year BETWEEN 2000 AND 2005
      AND CAST(strftime('%Y', d.dob) AS INTEGER) < 1985
      AND r.laps > 50
)
SELECT 
    CASE 
        WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT d2000_2005.driverId) = 0 THEN 0
        ELSE ROUND(
            100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT db.driverId) * 1.0 / COUNT(DISTINCT d2000_2005.driverId),
            2
        )
    END AS percentage
FROM Drivers_2000_2005 d2000_2005
LEFT JOIN Drivers_Born_Before_1985_Over_50_Laps db ON d2000_2005.driverId = db.driverId

WITH max_strength AS (
    SELECT MAX(ha.attribute_value) AS max_val
    FROM hero_attribute ha
    JOIN attribute a ON ha.attribute_id = a.id
    WHERE a.attribute_name = 'Strength'
)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT ha.hero_id) AS hero_count
FROM hero_attribute ha
JOIN attribute a ON ha.attribute_id = a.id
JOIN max_strength ms ON ha.attribute_value = ms.max_val
WHERE a.attribute_name = 'Strength'

WITH strength_attr AS (
    SELECT id FROM attribute WHERE attribute_name = 'Strength'
),
max_strength AS (
    SELECT MAX(attribute_value) AS max_val
    FROM hero_attribute
    WHERE attribute_id = (SELECT id FROM strength_attr)
)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT hero_id) AS hero_count
FROM hero_attribute
WHERE attribute_id = (SELECT id FROM strength_attr)
  AND attribute_value = (SELECT max_val FROM max_strength)

        COUNT(CASE WHEN strftime('%Y', Date) = '2010' THEN 1 END) AS Count2010,
        COUNT(CASE WHEN strftime('%Y', Date) = '2011' THEN 1 END) AS Count2011,
        COUNT(*) AS TotalCount
    FROM badges
    WHERE Name = 'Student'
)
SELECT 
    (CAST(Count2010 AS FLOAT) / TotalCount) * 100 - (CAST(Count2011 AS FLOAT) / TotalCount) * 100 AS PercentageDifference
FROM BadgeCounts

WITH total_student_badges AS (
    SELECT COUNT(*) AS total
    FROM badges
    WHERE Name = 'Student'
),
badges_2010 AS (
    SELECT COUNT(*) AS count_2010
    FROM badges
    WHERE Name = 'Student' AND strftime('%Y', Date) = '2010'
),
badges_2011 AS (
    SELECT COUNT(*) AS count_2011
    FROM badges
    WHERE Name = 'Student' AND strftime('%Y', Date) = '2011'
)
SELECT 
    ((b2010.count_2010 * 1.0 / tsb.total) * 100) - ((b2011.count_2011 * 1.0 / tsb.total) * 100) AS percentage_difference
FROM total_student_badges tsb
CROSS JOIN badges_2010 b2010
CROSS JOIN badges_2011 b2011

WITH total AS (
    SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_count
    FROM badges
    WHERE Name = 'Student'
),
year_counts AS (
    SELECT 
        STRFTIME('%Y', Date) AS year,
        COUNT(*) AS year_count
    FROM badges
    WHERE Name = 'Student' AND (STRFTIME('%Y', Date) = '2010' OR STRFTIME('%Y', Date) = '2011')
    GROUP BY year
)
SELECT 
    ( (CAST((SELECT year_count FROM year_counts WHERE year = '2010') AS FLOAT) / total.total_count) * 100
    - (CAST((SELECT year_count FROM year_counts WHERE year = '2011') AS FLOAT) / total.total_count) * 100
    ) AS percentage_difference
FROM total

WITH total_cards AS (
    SELECT COUNT(id) AS total_count FROM cards
),
story_spotlight_textless AS (
    SELECT id FROM cards WHERE isStorySpotlight = 1 AND isTextless = 1
),
story_spotlight_notextbox AS (
    SELECT id FROM cards WHERE isStorySpotlight = 1 AND isTextless = 0
),
count_story_spotlight_notextbox AS (
    SELECT COUNT(id) AS count_no_textbox FROM story_spotlight_notextbox
)
SELECT 
    (count_no_textbox * 100.0) / total_count AS percentage_story_spotlight_no_textbox,
    story_spotlight_notextbox.id
FROM 
    count_story_spotlight_notextbox, total_cards
JOIN 
    story_spotlight_notextbox ON 1=1

FROM (
  SELECT m.molecule_id, COUNT(a.atom_id) AS oxygen_count
  FROM molecule m
  JOIN atom a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id
  WHERE a.element = 'o'
  GROUP BY m.molecule_id
) o

  SELECT DISTINCT molecule_id
  FROM bond
  WHERE bond_type = '-'
) b ON o.molecule_id = b.molecule_id

FROM 
  atom a
JOIN 
  connected c ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id
JOIN 
  bond b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
WHERE 
  b.bond_type = '-'

SELECT 
  100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN a.element = 'cl' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(a.atom_id) AS percent
FROM 
  molecule m
JOIN 
  bond b ON m.molecule_id = b.molecule_id AND b.bond_type = '-'
JOIN 
  atom a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id

WITH EnrollmentDiff AS (
    SELECT 
        frpm.CDSCode,
        (frpm.`Enrollment (K-12)` - frpm.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)`) AS diff
    FROM frpm
    JOIN schools ON frpm.CDSCode = schools.CDSCode
    WHERE schools.FundingType = 'Local'
),
AvgDiff AS (
    SELECT AVG(diff) AS avg_diff FROM EnrollmentDiff
)
SELECT 
    schools.School,
    schools.DOCType
FROM EnrollmentDiff
JOIN schools ON EnrollmentDiff.CDSCode = schools.CDSCode
JOIN AvgDiff
WHERE EnrollmentDiff.diff > AvgDiff.avg_diff
  AND schools.FundingType = 'Local'

WITH enrollment_diff AS (
    SELECT 
        s.CDSCode,
        s.School,
        s.DOCType,
        frpm.`Enrollment (K-12)` - frpm.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)` AS diff
    FROM schools s
    JOIN frpm ON s.CDSCode = frpm.CDSCode

      AND frpm.`Enrollment (K-12)` IS NOT NULL
      AND frpm.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)` IS NOT NULL
)

    SELECT AVG(diff) AS avg_diff_val FROM enrollment_diff
)

FROM enrollment_diff, avg_diff

WITH RankedSchools AS (
    SELECT
        s.School,
        s.County,
        ss.AvgScrRead,
        RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY s.County ORDER BY ss.AvgScrRead DESC) AS rank_in_county
    FROM
        schools s
    JOIN
        satscores ss ON s.CDSCode = ss.cds
    WHERE
        s.Virtual = 'T' AND ss.AvgScrRead IS NOT NULL
)

FROM

WHERE
    rank_in_county <= 5
ORDER BY

    rank_in_county

JOIN district d ON c.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE c.gender = 'M'
  AND d.A3 = 'North Bohemia'
  AND d.A11 > 8000

WITH
-- Find the highest and lowest average salary from district
salary_stats AS (
    SELECT
        MAX(A11) AS max_salary,
        MIN(A11) AS min_salary
    FROM district
),
-- Find the districts with the lowest average salary
lowest_salary_districts AS (
    SELECT district_id
    FROM district, salary_stats
    WHERE A11 = min_salary
),
-- Find the oldest birth_date among female clients in the lowest salary districts
oldest_female_birth_date AS (
    SELECT MIN(birth_date) AS oldest_birth_date
    FROM client
    WHERE gender = 'F'
      AND district_id IN (SELECT district_id FROM lowest_salary_districts)
),
-- Find female clients who are oldest and in lowest salary districts
oldest_female_clients AS (
    SELECT client_id
    FROM client, oldest_female_birth_date
    WHERE gender = 'F'
      AND district_id IN (SELECT district_id FROM lowest_salary_districts)
      AND birth_date = oldest_birth_date
),
-- Find accounts of these female clients
accounts_of_oldest_females AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT a.account_id
    FROM account a
    JOIN disp d ON a.account_id = d.account_id
    WHERE d.client_id IN (SELECT client_id FROM oldest_female_clients)
)
SELECT
    a.account_id,
    (ss.max_salary - ss.min_salary) AS salary_gap
FROM accounts_of_oldest_females a
CROSS JOIN salary_stats ss
ORDER BY a.account_id

WITH FemaleClients AS (
    SELECT c.client_id, c.district_id, c.birth_date
    FROM client c
    WHERE c.gender = 'F'
),
OldestBirthDate AS (
    SELECT MIN(birth_date) AS oldest_birth_date
    FROM FemaleClients
),
LowestAvgSalary AS (
    SELECT MIN(d.A11) AS lowest_avg_salary
    FROM district d
    JOIN FemaleClients fc ON d.district_id = fc.district_id
    JOIN OldestBirthDate ob ON fc.birth_date = ob.oldest_birth_date
),
HighestAvgSalary AS (
    SELECT MAX(A11) AS highest_avg_salary
    FROM district
),
OldestLowestSalaryAccounts AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT a.account_id
    FROM account a
    JOIN disp dp ON a.account_id = dp.account_id
    JOIN FemaleClients fc ON dp.client_id = fc.client_id
    JOIN OldestBirthDate ob ON fc.birth_date = ob.oldest_birth_date
    JOIN LowestAvgSalary las ON 1=1
    JOIN district d ON fc.district_id = d.district_id
    WHERE d.A11 = las.lowest_avg_salary
)
SELECT 
    ola.account_id,
    (has.highest_avg_salary - las.lowest_avg_salary) AS salary_gap
FROM OldestLowestSalaryAccounts ola
CROSS JOIN LowestAvgSalary las
CROSS JOIN HighestAvgSalary has

WITH FirstApprovedLoan AS (
    SELECT l.account_id
    FROM loan l
    WHERE l.status = 'approved' AND l.date >= '1993-07-05' AND l.date < '1993-07-06'
    ORDER BY l.date ASC, l.loan_id ASC
    LIMIT 1
),
Balances AS (
    SELECT 
        t.account_id,
        t.date,
        t.balance
    FROM trans t
    JOIN FirstApprovedLoan f ON t.account_id = f.account_id
    WHERE t.date IN ('1993-03-22', '1998-12-27')
)
SELECT 
    CASE 
        WHEN b1.balance = 0 THEN NULL
        ELSE ((b2.balance - b1.balance) * 100.0 / b1.balance)
    END AS increase_rate
FROM 
    (SELECT balance FROM Balances WHERE date = '1993-03-22') b1,
    (SELECT balance FROM Balances WHERE date = '1998-12-27') b2

        t.account_id,
